topic.zh: 聚焦建筑能耗预测方向，研究「Physics-informed neural networks」在真实建成环境中的适用性与边界条件，回应了该子领域近年最受关注的落地问题。
topic.en: Within Building Energy Prediction, the paper studies how "Physics-informed neural networks" behaves in real built-environment settings and where its boundary conditions lie.

method.zh: 以 Graph Neural Network 为核心方法，配合机理约束与消融实验，系统对比了主流基线，实验设计完整、可复现。
method.en: Graph Neural Network is the core approach, combined with physics-informed constraints and ablations against mainstream baselines in a reproducible setup.

data.zh: 使用示范项目的全过程数据进行验证，数据规模与标注质量在同类研究中属于较高水平。
data.en: Validation uses full-process data from a demonstration project; the scale and label quality are strong for this literature.

findings.zh: 相对最优基线取得 20%–31% 的一致提升，且误差分布更稳定；失败案例分析给出了清晰的适用边界。
findings.en: It delivers consistent 20%–31% gains over the best baseline with tighter error spread, and the failure analysis maps the method's limits.

limits.zh: 主要局限：跨建筑类型的泛化未充分测试。
limits.en: Main limitation: generalisation across building types is not fully tested.

relevance.zh: 发表于 Energy and Buildings，为后续综述与标准制定提供了关键证据，值得纳入相关综述的核心证据链。
relevance.en: Published in Energy and Buildings, it supplies key evidence for future reviews and standards — worth a place in the core evidence chain of a review.

method.zh: 以 Transformer 为核心方法，配合机理约束与消融实验，系统对比了主流基线，实验设计完整、可复现。
method.en: Transformer is the core approach, combined with physics-informed constraints and ablations against mainstream baselines in a reproducible setup.

data.zh: 使用真实运行监测数据进行验证，数据规模与标注质量在同类研究中属于较高水平。
data.en: Validation uses real operational monitoring data; the scale and label quality are strong for this literature.

findings.zh: 相对最优基线取得 12%–18% 的一致提升，且误差分布更稳定；失败案例分析给出了清晰的适用边界。
findings.en: It delivers consistent 12%–18% gains over the best baseline with tighter error spread, and the failure analysis maps the method's limits.

limits.zh: 主要局限：样本局限于单一气候区，外推性有待验证。
limits.en: Main limitation: samples come from one climate zone, so transfer needs validation.

relevance.zh: 发表于 Building and Environment，为该方向提供了可复现的基线与开源实现，值得纳入相关综述的核心证据链。
relevance.en: Published in Building and Environment, it offers a reproducible baseline with an open implementation — worth a place in the core evidence chain of a review.

topic.zh: 聚焦生成式设计方向，研究「Diffusion models」在真实建成环境中的适用性与边界条件，回应了该子领域近年最受关注的落地问题。

method.zh: 以 Physics-Informed AI 为核心方法，配合机理约束与消融实验，系统对比了主流基线，实验设计完整、可复现。
method.en: Physics-Informed AI is the core approach, combined with physics-informed constraints and ablations against mainstream baselines in a reproducible setup.

data.zh: 使用示范项目的全过程数据进行验证，数据规模与标注质量在同类研究中属于较高水平。

findings.zh: 相对最优基线取得 20%–31% 的一致提升，且误差分布更稳定；失败案例分析给出了清晰的适用边界。

limits.zh: 主要局限：跨建筑类型的泛化未充分测试。

relevance.zh: 发表于 Building and Environment，为后续综述与标准制定提供了关键证据，值得纳入相关综述的核心证据链。
